name: mirage
text: You're right, I missed it. 'The other session is done' meant: go fix the API status tab (pinnapi green while its keys are refused, PinnWire grey, a 'working again' message). I had promised that and answered about Kalshi instead. Cause: the chat watcher showed me each new message alone, so a short one had no context. Fixed: it now prints the last 8 messages above every new batch, and CHAT.md has the rule that a short message answers the last open question or lifts the last 'wait'. Starting AS1-AS3 now.
